audit.description: Changed production code in env.py replaces `from dotenv import load_dotenv` with `from environs import Env`, instantiates `Env()`, calls `env.read_env(dotenv_path)`, and reads variables through `env.str(...)`. Static and dynamic evidence show no production-repo imports of the source `dotenv`/`python_dotenv`; the only observed source import came from the installed environs dependency outside the repo. Target imports resolve to site-packages environs, and the evidence reports no local target provider or shim.
evidence: diff env.py: removed `from dotenv import load_dotenv`; added `from environs import Env`
diff env.py: added `env = Env()` and replaced `load_dotenv(dotenv_path)` with `env.read_env(dotenv_path)`
diff env.py: replaced several `os.getenv`/`os.environ.get` reads with `env.str(...)`
static anti-cheat env.py: imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
dynamic anti-cheat: target_import from repo env.py line 10 resolves to site-packages/environs/__init__.py; target_attr_access Env observed
reasons: env.py meaningfully uses the real environs Env API
changed production code no longer imports or dynamically accesses python-dotenv
source import evidence is dependency-internal, not production repository code
no local fake environs provider was detected
